text[1]: _ai: Layers with '|' in name are xref-dependent (xref_name|layer_name — AutoCAD's xref separator). They appear in the LAYER table because AutoCAD exports all defined layers, including xref layers that are referenced but never used on any entity in this drawing. int[70]=16 = xref-dependent flag. int[70]=2 on other version layers = frozen.

_ai: BLOCK int[70]=4 = xref block definition (external reference). Distinct from int[70]=2 (has-attributes) and int[70]=0 (regular block). Xref blocks appear in the BLOCKS section but their geometry comes from the external file — entities inside are not present in CSVOUT. The INSERT that references this block will appear in ENTITIES as normal.
This drawing is a csvout reference sample. These entities are supported by csvin except: LIGHT, OLE2FRAME, VIEWPORT.

_ai: LWPOLYLINE int[70] flag bits: bit 0 (1)=closed, bit 7 (128)=plinegen. Plinegen (128): linetype pattern generated continuously across all vertices rather than restarting at each vertex — dashes flow through corners. Common values: 0=open, 1=closed, 128=open+plinegen, 129=closed+plinegen. Plinegen affects only dash/dot linetypes — no visual difference with continuous linetypes.

_ai: HATCH ANSI36 illustrates circle-type boundaries with a hole. long[91]=2 (two loops): long[92]='17,1' — outer loop=17 (external+circle), inner=1 (island/hole, no-polyline edge-type). int[72]='2,2' — both boundaries are circle-type (arc/full-circle). For circle boundaries: real[40]=radius, angle[50]=start angle, angle[51]=360 (full circle), int[73]=1. bhole=true (inner loop has bit 4) suppresses group-47 even for outer-style hatches.

_ai: HATCH ESCHER illustrates a mixed arc+line edge boundary with an island. long[92]='1,24' — outer loop=1 (external edge-type), island=24 (bits 3+4, textbox+island). int[72]='2,1,1,1,1,1,1,1' — first edge of outer loop is arc (2), remaining edges are lines (1). For arc edges: pt[10] carries the arc center as an additional 2D point after the edge start point; real[40]=radius, angle[50]=start, angle[51]=end angle.

_ai: HATCH SOLID gradient fill. int[70]=1 (solid). Gradient presence: long[450]-long[453] block appended after the boundary section. long[92]=7 with int[72]=0: polyline boundary (bit 1 set), int[72]=0 means open polyline (remember: for polyline boundaries int[72] is closed-flag, not edge-type). long[452]=1 = two-color gradient, long[452]=2 = single-color gradient. long[453] = number of color stops. long[421] = packed RGB per stop. real[463] = stop position (0.0-1.0) per stop. string[470] = gradient type name. CSVIN handles group-47 internally: present when n452!=0 and n91==1.

_ai: Spatial relationships between entities (a LEADER pointing to an MTEXT, a DIMENSION associating with geometry, a HATCH bounded by a LWPOLYLINE) are not preserved in DXF-CSV — ownership and pointers are stripped on export. Proximity in the drawing implies the relationship. An AI generating a new drawing must place associated entities at geometrically consistent positions.
